about: Osier stood twice (owner 2026-11-12): the quest's row becomes the one period Osier

entries.sql: UPDATE Mob SET Realm = 0, Flags = Flags & ~16, RespawnInterval = 720 WHERE Mob_ID = '28a63f87-3e68-550e-b3c0-1631cff581e6' AND PackageID = 'ClassicQuest'
entries.why: Freeing Osier: the peaceful quest Osier at the four standing stones and a hostile Osier 1,800 units away were two of one period monster. The quest's row is now that monster: no realm, attackable for his period drops, aggressive as his template says; the hostile duplicate leaves add-restoredspawns165.json (build_twins165.py PERIOD_TWINS). A player on the hand-in step is not attacked (QuestTalkTruce)
entries.source: Uthgard bestiary: Osier, Shannon Estuary, aggressive, with drops; Freeing Osier walkthrough: seek him at the standing stones and give him the bladder, do not fight him

entries.why: gamebots leave the quest's Osier alone, as they do the other quest monsters a player must talk to
